description: Source file implementing POSIX-based SOC interactions for Zephyr, including CPU control, interrupt handling, and initialization/cleanup routines.

methods.name: posix_is_cpu_running
methods.description: Checks if the CPU is currently running using the NCE interface.

methods.name: posix_change_cpu_state_and_wait
methods.description: Changes the CPU state to halted or running and waits for the change to take effect.

methods.name: posix_interrupt_raised
methods.description: Signals that an interrupt has been raised, waking the CPU.

methods.name: posix_halt_cpu
methods.description: Halts the CPU, typically called from arch_cpu_idle, and handles interrupt processing upon wake.

methods.name: posix_atomic_halt_cpu
methods.description: Performs an atomic halt of the CPU with interrupt mask handling.

methods.name: posix_boot_cpu
methods.description: Initializes and boots the CPU, spawning the Zephyr init thread.

methods.name: posix_soc_clean_up
methods.description: Cleans up resources allocated by the SOC and POSIX core.
